x-save-as-dialog.js: const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); [...document.querySelectorAll('.chip.pick')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Dragon')?.click(); await sleep(700); [...document.querySelectorAll('header button')].find(b => b.innerText.includes('Save as') || b.innerText.trim() === 'Save…')?.click(); await sleep(900);

x-new-from-results.js: const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const pick = [...document.querySelectorAll('.configpick')].find(p => p.innerText.includes('Weapon')); pick.querySelector('.mud-input').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(700); [...document.querySelectorAll('.mud-popover-open .mud-list-item')].find(e => e.innerText.includes('New weapon'))?.click(); await sleep(1200);

x-targets-speed-eat.js: const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const i = document.querySelector('.picker-tools input'); i.focus(); i.value = 'speed eat'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await sleep(700);
